purpose: diagnostic candidate for continuous-surface intermediate projection; no frozen-core change
backend: NumPy CPU; optional Numba acceleration if already installed

rasterization.primitive: projected triangles built from adjacent source depth-grid samples
rasterization.connectivity: same segmentation label and 3D edge length <= 4 local pixel footprints
rasterization.temporal_radiance: log-domain interpolation only when both endpoint surfaces have matching label and projected depth
rasterization.unknown_pixels: explicit render request; never filled by suppressing events or by changing the pixel threshold
rasterization.endpoint_policy: exact recorded endpoint image is authoritative
rasterization.depth_tie_tolerance: float32 numerical tie only, scaled to scene depth

pixel_response.radiometry: log of linear radiance; physical_log model used only in timing controls

controls: increasing and decreasing continuous depth slopes under +/-1e-5 px projected motion
analytic 0.25*X+Z=1 textured plane under +/-1 mm / 40 ms camera motion
positive and negative 0.5 log-radiance ramps over 10 ms
